column2: I built a doghouse and everything, planning to get a dog... But I decided to get a cat after all! ...Still, a dog's hard to give up too. Hmm, what should I do?
I'm terribly sorry, but we're fully booked at the moment. We can't offer you a room.
Ryoma Nagare-sama, you say? ...Hmm? I don't see the name Ryoma Nagare-sama among our guests.
Due to the emergency, by order of our owner, Uryu-sama, this hotel is free of charge for you and the other designated guests.
The owner of this hotel is supposedly a young entrepreneur. A researcher said he invests in Science City too.
I passed a guest with bandages all over his face on the third floor. If he's that badly hurt, he should be in the hospital.
The hotel TV channels are nothing but news programs. Looking at your faces, for some reason I suddenly feel like watching some old-time anime.
The room at the far left seems to be staff only. Someone from the hotel told me there's a machine in there that controls the groundwater.
A boy suddenly popped out of a manhole in the middle of town. Was he playing in the sewers?

At some point a strange wall appeared east of Science City. There are gates with no nameplates to the north, south, east and west, so it looks like someone's house, but who could live in a place like that?
Have you heard the strange rumor about the big cemetery east of Science City? There's never a caretaker in sight, but it's always swept spotless.
I feel like I've seen the bronze statue in the hallway somewhere before. And the Jizo statues all over the world look kind of like someone too...
I got sent to Science City, so I'm living in a hotel away from my family. I'm researching anti-gravity propulsion, but I worry it'll be misused for weapons.
It's a fine hotel inside and out, but the roof cleaning is shoddy. I went up there a while ago and there were weeds growing here and there.
This floor smells funny, and there are odd footprints too. I bet someone's staying here with some kind of big pet.
First I've heard of this Uryu Conglomerate that invests in Science City. Besides the two great Iyahaya and Hatesate conglomerates, there was another big-money family?
They say a weapon called the Mind Destroyer Gun has been put into use. The researcher is supposedly a villain hunter, so weapons development was permitted.
The Photon Power Lab receives government funding too. They say developing robots takes an enormous amount of money.
The elevator on the right goes straight to the command room, and the one on the left to the underground hangar.
If there's any equipment you need, feel free to take it. Professor Yumi has given permission.
Aphrodite A's body is Alloy Z, and Mazinger Z's is Super Alloy Z. Boss Borot's is... scrap iron? Whoops, that's rude to Boss.
They say the Mechanical Beasts slept in the ruins on Bardos Island for thousands of years. Was there a genius scientist like Dr. Juzo Kabuto in ancient Mykene?
The lab uses as much power as a small town. But since we generate it with photon power energy, we're never short.
The top of this hangar is disguised as a sewage treatment pool. What? Everyone knows? Hmmm... Why is that?
There's nothing underground but the hangar for the Getter Machines and the engine room. The infirmary is the room north along the wall. The lab exit is far to the west.
We had a hard time finding Getter Robo's pilots. We screened over 300 young people with strong wills and stamina.
Looking at the pilot test results, Musashi Tomoe-kun's aptitude is low, but his body's way more thick-skinned... I mean, tougher than the other two's.
I'm working on a way to use the Getter Beam to defend the lab. The Reptilians can't stand Getter Beams, you see.
All these all-nighters have given me an awful headache... The infirmary is the corner room in the northeast of the first floor, but getting there is a pain...
Some scientists consider Getter Rays dangerous. Just as nuclear power comes with radioactive contamination, we have to accept a little risk.
East of Mamii Pharmacy there's a Science City scrapyard. It may be scrap, but it's Science City scrap, right? Some dangerous things must be dumped in there too. I wish they'd dispose of it properly.
You saw the barricade outside the house, right? Beyond it is an area off-limits to the general public. There's supposedly a condo in there, but I don't know the details.
I hear there's an operation going on next door... Normally you'd do that in a hospital, right?
Lately the world's in an uproar over rioters and the Demon King. ...Maybe this is no time to keep doing research?
I'm thinking of getting a pet. The classic choice is a dog or a cat, right? Which should I pick... I've got to think it over carefully.
The students and teachers at this town's school are so noisy, I can't stand it! I can't believe they're having proper lessons.

I thought the school had been quiet lately, and it turns out the students stopped coming. The world's so dangerous these days, maybe that's why. But I've heard voices like someone giving a lesson... Was I imagining it?
Here to visit {s}-sama? She's in the room on the right of the first floor.
For an examination, please go to the room on the left of the first floor.
Here to visit this girl? Don't worry, rest assured. It may take time, but her illness will be cured for sure.
You lot again? What's the matter? Who's getting admitted this time?
It's fine to be dedicated to research, but you have to keep from getting run down. Treatment matters, but so does prevention.\n\nSo many people here never think about that...
The other day a whole crowd of wounded people was suddenly brought in, and I was shocked. Then I learned about the rioters on TV and was even more shocked.
Hunting yokai? Sounds like fun!
Enma-kun headed to the nearby town. Where the school was, right? Let's hurry too!
What a strange building...\n\nIt's way bigger inside than it looks from outside.
It's to meet Great King Enma. It's scary, but let's do our best!
The Dark Temple is supposed to be deep in the mountains west of here. ...I hope we can find some kind of clue there.
The Dark Temple... What a creepy name for a temple... And I feel a strange chill. What could it be?
Are oni born that way? Or are they humans who've transformed?
Getting a prophet to tell the future, huh? Sounds kinda fun! Herai Village is... north of Science City, I think they said.
The future is visible only to those who try to carve it out.
I ain't met anybody special lately, I do declare. I want my fortune told...
Honey and the others have already left. Let's hurry to Science City too!
Akira and the others have already left. Let's hurry to Science City too!
I'm scared... But I have to do my best!
The world is starting to crumble... That's how it feels...!
Everyone's in the Japanese-style room on the first floor. They're waiting for you, {p}. Hurry and go see them. Something good's sure to happen!
Everyone's waiting for you in the Japanese-style room on the first floor, {p}. C'mon, hurry! Something good's gonna happen for sure!
Everyone's in the Japanese-style room on the first floor. They're waiting for you, {p}. Hurry and go see them. Something good's sure to happen!
The fate of the world rests on you. I'm counting on you, everyone!
